status: PROPOSED; not registered or approved; not an executable profile
purpose: minimum descriptive binding to the existing hosted interpreter; no new ISA semantics

opcode_map.encoding: ASCII lines decimal-byte TAB existing opcode_name LF, ascending byte
opcode_map.membership: existing named opcode values only; names do not prove implemented behavior or verified conformance

raw_api: unchanged raw13 with three i32 operands; not full Program serialization
payload_codec: separate explicitly selected native saved-Program codec; not inferred from execution descriptor
build_binding_required: exact binary digest and build record
compiler, target ABI, flags and all feature definitions
supported payload ABI and enabled runtime features
execution_inputs_separate: injected entropy, budgets, tier/configuration and host-service settings

existing_semantic_anchors.Load/Store: current direct memory addresses B/A, not proposed register-indirect semantics
existing_semantic_anchors.JumpIfZero/JumpIfNotZero: current immediate target A and tested register B
existing_semantic_anchors.faults: existing VM trap enum, tick/PC/trace and policy behavior unchanged; no atomic-fault redesign

qualification: Source-inspected anchors; no new VM execution. Descriptor association with a binary requires review/build/test evidence. No cross-platform equivalence claim.
non_claims: not normative tisc-v2.0 or TISC v1.1.0 certification
not acceptance of all existing extensions or stub behavior
implementation_semantics_reference: existing implementation at source_tree; discrepancies against normative specs remain unresolved
